property_summary: A call to play() reverts exactly when the attached value is not exactly 10 wei, and whenever it succeeds with exactly 10 wei it must transfer the entire pot (minus a 1 wei fee) to the caller and reset the pot to zero, or leave the pot at 10 wei, with the contract's balance never increasing by more than 10 wei.

confirmed_difference.thread_focus: whether a call `play(args)` reverts or completes, and on which inputs
